description: Set an account's limits and, optionally, the markets it may use with a cap for each. Refuses a minimum ratio at or below any market's own minimum. Binds session keys, not the owner. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data for the owner's own wallet; simulated first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

approvalThreshold.description: Above this, the owner must approve the exact action, in USDG as a decimal string, e.g. "11" or "25.5"

cap.description: Cap for this market, or "0" to remove it, in USDG as a decimal string, e.g. "11" or "25.5"

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

maxActionSize.description: Largest single action. Nothing above this runs, approved or not, in USDG as a decimal string, e.g. "11" or "25.5"

minCollateralRatioPct.description: Minimum ratio after a risk-increasing action, as a percentage, e.g. "250"

mintBudget.description: Total value one session may mint over its life, in USDG as a decimal string, e.g. "11" or "25.5"

totalCollateralCap.description: Total collateral across all markets, in USDG as a decimal string, e.g. "11" or "25.5"

name: prepare_mandate_set_limits
title: Prepare mandate limits
